_note: The one list of CAN IDs on the bench bus (v2.13, integration plan P0). tests: CanIdRegistryTests fails if the DBC, the C++ core, the firmware or the Python bench uses an ID that is not here, or if an 'active' ID is missing from the DBC. 'reserved' = planned, not used yet. 'elsewhere' = IDs used by related projects on THEIR own bus; listed so a merge never puts a clash on this wire.

bus.note: classic CAN on the two-board HiL bus (MCP2515 at 500 kbit/s); PLN_Command is CAN FD (16 bytes) on the virtual and CAN-process levels

ids.name: SAF_Status
ids.e2e: CRC8H2F over bytes 1-7 + data ID 0x201, 8-bit alive counter (v2.9.6)

ids.name: UDS_Functional
ids.note: functional TesterPresent: lists every node that answers

ids.name: UDS_SafetyNode_Req
ids.note: 0x7E0 avoided: the CAN IDS demo's ECU_SPOOF attack uses it

elsewhere.name: ACC_Status
elsewhere.note: CLASH with PLN_Command; the demo keeps its own virtual bus (move to 0x180 if it ever shares this wire)

elsewhere.name: HIL_Stim
elsewhere.note: CLASH with SAF_ActuatorCmd (move to 0x280 if it ever shares this wire)

elsewhere.name: engine_rpm
elsewhere.note: retired in P3: the IDS learns the safe-stop messages instead

elsewhere.name: ECU_SPOOF target
elsewhere.note: attack target ID; P3 attacks will aim at the IDs above instead
